title: SQLMorph: Query Mutation and Fine-Grained Metrics for Text-to-SQL Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2609.08950v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-to-SQL systems translate natural language queries into executable SQL, democratizing access to structured data. Despite recent advances driven by large language models (LLMs), evaluation remains a major bottleneck: public benchmarks fail to capture the complexity of enterprise schema, while building private evaluation sets is costly and nondeterministic, making evaluation results difficult to reproduce. To address this issue, we present SQLMorph, a framework for Text-to-SQL evaluation via query mutation. SQLMorph introduces two techniques to automatically generate and expand evaluation sets: Join Query Expansion (JQE), which systematically increases structural complexity through valid join additions, and Textual Query Augmentation (TQA), which generates controlled natural language perturbations to assess robustness to linguistic variation. translated_abstract: Text-to-SQL系统将自然语言查询转换为可执行的SQL，使结构化数据的访问变得大众化。尽管近年来由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的技术取得了进展，但评估仍然是一个主要瓶颈：公开基准测试无法捕捉企业级数据库模式的复杂性，而构建私有评估集成本高昂且具有不确定性，导致评估结果难以复现。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了SQLMorph，一个通过查询变异进行Text-to-SQL评估的框架。SQLMorph引入了两种自动生成和扩展评估集的技术：连接查询扩展（JQE），通过有效添加连接操作系统地增加结构复杂性；以及文本查询增强（TQA），生成受控的自然语言扰动以评估系统对语言变化的鲁棒性。JQE和TQA创建有针对性的关键挑战点来测试特定的系统组件。当应……
tldr: SQLMorph提出了一种基于查询变异的Text-to-SQL评估框架，通过连接查询扩展（JQE）和文本查询增强（TQA）两项技术自动生成并扩展评估集，解决公开基准无法覆盖企业模式复杂性、私有评估集难以复现的问题。
en_tdlr: SQLMorph is a query mutation framework for Text-to-SQL evaluation that automatically generates and expands benchmarks through Join Query Expansion (JQE) and Textual Query Augmentation (TQA), addressing the complexity and reproducibility limitations of existing evaluation sets.
